## Getting Started

Python can be easy to pick up whether you're a first time programmer or you're experienced with other languages. The following pages are a useful first step to get on your way writing programs with Python!

- [Beginner's Guide, Programmers](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/Programmers)
- [Beginner's Guide, Non-Programmers](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/NonProgrammers)
- [Beginner's Guide, Download & Installation](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/Download)
- [Code sample and snippets for Beginners](https://wiki.python.org/moin/BeginnersGuide/Examples)

## Friendly & Easy to Learn

The community hosts conferences and meetups, collaborates on code, and much more. Python's documentation will help you along the way, and the mailing lists will keep you in touch.

- [Conferences and Workshops](https://www.python.org/community/workshops/)
- [Python Documentation](http://docs.python.org/)
- [Mailing Lists](https://www.python.org/community/lists) and [IRC channels](https://www.python.org/community/irc/)

## Applications

The [Python Package Index (PyPI)](https://pypi.python.org/) hosts thousands of third-party modules for Python. Both Python's standard library and the community-contributed modules allow for endless possibilities.

- [Web and Internet Development](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#web-and-internet-development)
- [Database Access](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#database-access)
- [Desktop GUIs](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#desktop-guis)
- [Scientific & Numeric](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#scientific-and-numeric)
- [Education](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#education)
- [Network Programming](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#network-programming)
- [Software & Game Development](https://www.python.org/about/apps/#software-development)

## Open-source

Python is developed under an OSI-approved open source license, making it freely usable and distributable, even for commercial use. Python's license is administered by the [Python Software Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf).

- [Learn more about the license](https://docs.python.org/license.html)
- [Python license on OSI](https://opensource.org/license/pythonsoftfoundation-php/)
- [Learn more about the Foundation](https://www.python.org/psf-landing/)

Can’t find what you’re looking for? [Try our comprehensive Help section](https://www.python.org/about/help/)

The mission of the Python Software Foundation is to promote, protect, and advance the Python programming language, and to support and facilitate the growth of a diverse and international community of Python programmers. [Learn more](https://www.python.org/psf/)

results.input: Bạn có thể hỗ trợ nghiên cứu và xử lý bản tin như thế nào?

result.actual_text:
Tôi có thể hỗ trợ bạn trong nghiên cứu và xử lý bản tin theo nhiều cách khác nhau, bao gồm:

1. **Tìm kiếm thông tin**: Tôi có thể tìm kiếm thông tin và tin tức liên quan đến một chủ đề cụ thể mà bạn quan tâm.

2. **Tóm tắt bài viết**: Nếu bạn cung cấp một URL, tôi có thể đọc và tóm tắt nội dung của bài viết đó.

3. **Lấy bài đăng từ mạng xã hội**: Tôi có thể lấy các bài đăng gần đây từ một tài khoản mạng xã hội cụ thể hoặc tìm kiếm các bài đăng theo từ khóa.

4. **Tìm kiếm tài liệu khoa học**: Tôi có thể tìm kiếm và cung cấp thông tin về các bài báo khoa học liên quan đến một chủ đề cụ thể.

5. **Xử lý và định dạng dữ liệu**: Tôi có thể giúp bạn định dạng dữ liệu đã có thành văn bản dễ đọc hoặc tóm tắt.

Nếu bạn có yêu cầu cụ thể nào, hãy cho tôi biết để tôi có thể hỗ trợ bạn tốt hơn!

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: Autonomous EV developer Humble Robotics adds $51M to expand - TT
items.summary:
Humble Robotics raised $51 million in Series A financing, bringing its total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding.
 The company is developing the Humble Hauler, a battery-electric, cabless Class 8 autonomous vehicle for regional freight routes under 250 miles.
 Humble will fund customer pilots, testing, early manufacturing and expansion into vehicles for 40-foot containers and 53-foot dry van and refrigerated trailers. [...] Stay on top of transportation news: [Get TTNews in your inbox.]

Humble Robotics secured $51 million in new financing, bringing the autonomous electric vehicle developer’s total funding to $75 million less than a year after its founding. [...] The Hauler uses vision-language-action models and is equipped with cameras, lidar and radar that provide 360-degree coverage of its surroundings. The battery-electric skateboard platform has an aerodynamic shield at the front, while shipping containers can be attached through a twist-lock interface.

items.title: FDA seeks input on telesurgery, autonomous robotics
items.summary: Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning and connectivity are driving expansion of robotic applications in a wide range of clinical settings, the FDA said. Increases in processing power, data storage and computational efficiency are enabling progress in robotic systems with autonomous capabilities. [...] In another example of teleoperation, manufacturers are developing devices that enable technicians to remotely perform ultrasounds, the FDA said. Robotic devices include stereotactic navigation systems, imaging devices and endoluminal navigation devices. [...] The FDA is asking the robotics community to submit comments on the discussion paper by Jan. 5. Ahead of that deadline, a public workshop to discuss the topics raised in the paper is scheduled for Dec. 2-3.

items.title: NVIDIA launches GR00T 2 and Isaac Lab 3.0 at CoRL - The Robot Report
items.summary:
Walden Robotics is using Isaac Sim’s photorealistic rendering to train and evaluate its general-purpose robot in virtual environments for manufacturing and logistics. Dexmate is exploring how coding agents can rehearse and refine manipulation strategies in Isaac Sim before executing them on its Vega robot. [...] Robotics developers are already putting NVIDIA’s latest technology to the test. A number of developers are using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton. At CoRL, Skild AI announced Scalable Throughput-optimized Engine for Embodied Learning, or STEEL, a new rigid-body physics solver built on Newton to accelerate robot training with Isaac Lab. [...] Nexuni is testing GR00T 2 for robotic laundry. Foxconn is applying GR00T 2 to factory automation for server manufacturing, and Siemens is evaluating it across industrial use cases.

MicroAGI is using GR00T 2, post-trained through reinforcement learning, to perform Ethernet cable swapping with a YAM robotic arm. Its agentic robotics approach automates the creation and calibration of simulation environments using Isaac Lab 3.0 and Newton, where the policy is trained.

items.title: Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program earns regional recognition - ClarksvilleNow.com
items.summary:
“I am proud of the national-level success of Kenwood’s Robotics Team. It reflects the faculty, JROTC instructors, and cadets’ hard work and dedication toward creating an elite mindset at the school,” Lightner said.

Dr Nigel Anderson, Kenwood High School Principal, noted “The robotics program complements the leadership development and citizenship training provided through JROTC while exposing students to science, technology, engineering, and mathematics disciplines.” [...] CLARKSVILLE TN – The Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program has grown from a single robotics team into a four-team program that is competing successfully at regional and national-level events. The program currently fields Teams 26163X, 26163A, 26163L, and 26163S, providing students with opportunities to develop skills in engineering, programming, and problem-solving. [...] During the current robotics’ competition season, Team 26163X captured first place at the Tennessee State Fair Robotics Competition. The team followed that performance with another first-place finish at a competition in Elizabethton, Tennessee, where it also received a technical award recognizing excellence in robot design and engineering.
